_comment: Components of a control's expected state the assessment does not establish, whatever the tenant looks like: the evaluator does not read that evidence. Every surface that shows the control also shows 'Not established: <component>.', so a reader cannot take the verified half for the whole requirement. docs/TP-DETECTION-LIMITS.md explains each entry; add an entry here in the same change as the limitation.

Limits.Reason: The assessment verifies that compliance policies are assigned and cover each enrolled platform. It does not read the configured non-compliance actions (when a device is marked noncompliant, blocked, retired or otherwise acted upon), so it cannot prove that noncompliant devices lose access or that remediation happens. INT-1.1 therefore never returns Satisfied.
